note: SOSProf.net — 30 original Reel concepts, 5 per pillar. Scores are editorial estimates (business impact 30, audience 25, hook 15, originality 10, engagement 10, feasibility 10), not performance predictions. c = criteria 0-100: m=business impact, a=audience relevance, h=hook strength, o=originality, e=engagement potential, f=production feasibility. Features marked verify must be confirmed live on app.sosprof.net before publishing.

concepts.title: Ask dad… he says ask mum
concepts.objective: Reach non-followers with a shared family moment
concepts.pain: Nobody at home can answer a homework question at 10 pm
concepts.hook: تسأل بوك... يقلّك اسأل أمك!
concepts.concept: Mini-skit: a Bac student carries her notebook from dad (TV) to mum (kitchen) to big brother (gaming); each one sends her to the next. Last beat: she posts the question on the SOSProf.net community and gets an explanation.
concepts.message: A question shouldn't wait until tomorrow's class.

concepts.title: Two hours in the étude, zero understood
concepts.pain: Crowded group sessions where the student never dares to ask
concepts.hook: تقرى في étude وترجع للدار ما فهمت شيء؟
concepts.concept: POV in a packed room: 30 students, the teacher races through, our student's hand goes up and down three times. Split second: at home he replays the part he missed (verify: recordings per platform terms).
concepts.message: Learning works when someone takes time for your question.
concepts.cta: Find a teacher who explains at your pace

concepts.title: The tutoring commute
concepts.pain: Louage, traffic and waiting eat the evening before the lesson even starts
concepts.hook: قدّاش من مرّة مشيت تقرى ورجعت تعبان أكثر؟
concepts.concept: Micro-story with an on-screen clock: 17:00 leave school, 17:40 still waiting for transport, 18:30 lesson, 20:15 home exhausted. Rewind: same evening with an online session from the desk, the clock shows the time saved.
concepts.message: Your energy should go into learning, not into the road.
concepts.cta: Try an online session on sosprof.net

concepts.title: Your whole week rearranged for one session
concepts.objective: Engagement through a schedule pain point
concepts.pain: Fixed tutoring slots that clash with school, sport and family
concepts.hook: علاش لازمك تبدّل برنامجك الكل على خاطر حصة؟
concepts.concept: Split screen: left, a student moves sport, family dinner and revision around one rigid slot (sticky notes falling off a wall); right, she picks a slot that fits her week.
concepts.message: The lesson should fit your week, not the other way round.
concepts.cta: Choose the time that suits you

concepts.title: The night before the devoir
concepts.pain: Stuck on one exercise the night before a test, panic rising
concepts.hook: الساعة 11 متاع الليل، والفرض غدوة... وتمرين واحد واقف!
concepts.concept: Curiosity hook: tight close-ups (clock, crossed-out page, sigh), the reveal is held until 2/3 of the video: the exercise gets explained step by step in the community.
concepts.message: Stuck is normal. Staying stuck isn't necessary.
concepts.cta: Ask your question before the test

concepts.title: You choose your teacher
concepts.pain: Being assigned a teacher you never chose
concepts.hook: علاش تقبل بأستاذ ما اخترتوش إنتي؟
concepts.concept: Real screen recording: search a subject and level, open two teacher profiles, compare, choose. Zooms and highlights on the real UI, one benefit only.
concepts.message: On SOSProf.net you pick the teacher who fits you.

concepts.title: A question stuck? Someone answers
concepts.pain: Not knowing where to ask outside class
concepts.hook: سؤال واقفلك؟ فما شكون يجاوبك!
concepts.concept: Feature demo of the Forum: write a question, add a photo of the exercise, follow it, see an answer arrive. Real flow, French UI words kept as they appear.
concepts.message: Your questions get real answers in the community.

concepts.title: Replay the lesson
concepts.pain: Forgetting the explanation two days later
concepts.hook: تحب تعاود الحصة؟ شوف كيفاش!
concepts.concept: Before/after: notebook full of half-notes vs. replaying the exact minute of the explanation. Verify: recordings exist and their access rules before production.
concepts.message: Understand again, at your own pace (per platform terms).

concepts.title: Your teacher, your time
concepts.pain: Not finding a time slot that fits
concepts.hook: إنت تختار الأستاذ والوقت اللي يناسبك.
concepts.concept: Premium motion graphics: floating phone with the real calendar screen, kinetic Arabic type for teacher → slot → confirm. Real screenshots inside the mockup.
concepts.message: Booking takes three steps: teacher, time, confirm.

concepts.title: Not all support looks the same
concepts.objective: Show that services fit individual needs
concepts.pain: One-size tutoring packs that don't match the child
concepts.hook: موش لازم تشري حزمة كاملة، اختار اللي يلزمك.
concepts.concept: Explainer reel: three students, three needs (one question, a few sessions before the Bac, regular follow-up), each mapped to how it works on SOSProf.net. Verify which service types and price discussion are live.
concepts.message: Choose the support your child actually needs.

concepts.title: Teach on your own terms
concepts.pain: Wanting independence without knowing where to start
concepts.hook: إنت أستاذ وتحب تخدم باستقلالية؟
concepts.concept: Teacher POV: a teacher plans her own week on a whiteboard (her slots, her subjects, her levels), then fills in her SOSProf.net profile. Calm, professional tone.
concepts.message: SOSProf.net helps you organise your independent teaching.

concepts.title: Who decides your time?
concepts.objective: Reach teachers with a provocative question
concepts.pain: Schedules imposed by others
concepts.hook: علاش غيرك يقرّر وقتك؟
concepts.concept: Teacher Talk to camera (a real teacher who agreed to appear): 20 seconds on why choosing her own schedule changed how she teaches. No income claims.
concepts.message: Your schedule is yours to organise.

concepts.title: Let students discover you
concepts.pain: Great teachers that nobody outside their town knows
concepts.hook: عندك خبرة في التدريس؟ خلّي التلامذة يتعرّفوا عليك.
concepts.concept: Screen recording of a teacher profile being completed: photo, subjects, levels, presentation. Before/after of an empty vs complete profile (sample teacher with consent).
concepts.message: A complete profile is your professional showcase.

concepts.title: Your experience deserves more opportunities
concepts.pain: Feeling that years of experience aren't visible
concepts.hook: خبرتك تستحق فرص أكثر!
concepts.concept: Premium promotional reel: close-ups of a teacher's tools (chalk, marked copies, a tablet) cut to her profile going live on SOSProf.net. Music and SFX only, voiceover recorded by the user.
concepts.message: Make your expertise visible to the students who need it.

concepts.title: 60 seconds with a SOSProf teacher
concepts.pain: Not knowing what working with the platform looks like
concepts.hook: كيفاش يخدم أستاذ مستقل نهار عادي؟
concepts.concept: Mini-interview with a real teacher (consent): 3 questions on how she organises her sessions, how she answers in the community, what she'd tell a colleague. No numbers, no promises.
concepts.message: Teachers organise their activity their way on SOSProf.net.

concepts.title: The Bac maths trap
concepts.pain: Losing points on a classic mistake
concepts.hook: سؤال في الرياضيات يغلطوا فيه برشا تلامذة باك!
concepts.concept: Mini-lesson: one classic Bac mistake (e.g. forgetting the domain before solving a log equation), the wrong path in red, the right path in yellow, 3 steps. Checked by a maths teacher.
concepts.message: Check the domain first, it's free points.

concepts.title: 30-second challenge
concepts.pain: Revision feels passive
concepts.hook: تنجّم تحلّ التمرين هذا في 30 ثانية؟
concepts.concept: Quiz with an on-screen countdown: one physics or maths question, pause, solution with a clear reasoning. Answers in the comments, correction pinned.
concepts.message: Test yourself before the exam does.
concepts.cta: Write your answer in the comments

concepts.title: Avoid this in the devoir
concepts.pain: Repeating the same mistake every test
concepts.hook: الغلطة هاذي تنجم تتفاداها في الفرض.
concepts.concept: Animated explainer: the 3 most frequent writing mistakes in a physics answer (units, significant figures, missing justification), each with a before/after line.
concepts.message: Method earns points as much as the result.
concepts.cta: Save and share with your class

concepts.title: 3 things before the test
concepts.pain: Not knowing how to revise the evening before
concepts.hook: 3 حاجات لازم تعرفهم قبل الفرض!
concepts.concept: Carousel-style reel (or a 5-slide carousel): sleep, a 20-minute recap of formulas, one past exercise timed. Practical, no miracle claims.
concepts.message: A good last evening is organised, not stressful.
concepts.cta: Save it for your next test

concepts.title: Python in 45 seconds: the loop that confuses everyone
concepts.pain: Algorithmics feels abstract
concepts.hook: الـ boucle هاذي تلخبط برشا تلامذة... نفهموها في 45 ثانية؟
concepts.concept: Mini-lesson with a real code editor recording: a for loop with range, trace table filled live, one common off-by-one mistake. Verified against the Tunisian programme.
concepts.message: Trace your loop on paper and the bug shows itself.
concepts.cta: Ask your algo questions in the community

concepts.title: Meet the teachers
concepts.pain: Not knowing who is behind an online platform
concepts.hook: تعرّف على الأساتذة الموجودين في SOSProf.net.
concepts.concept: Series opener: one real teacher (consent) per episode introduces herself in 15 s: subject, levels, how she explains. Only teachers who agreed to appear.
concepts.message: Real teachers, real expertise.

concepts.title: How a question gets answered
concepts.pain: Doubting that anyone actually answers
concepts.hook: شوف كيفاش يتجاوب على سؤال في المجتمع التفاعلي.
concepts.concept: Community demonstration: follow one real (anonymised) question from posting to answer, with timestamps from the real thread. Private data blurred.
concepts.message: The community answers, you can see it.

concepts.title: How to choose the right teacher
concepts.pain: Overwhelmed by choice
concepts.hook: كيفاش تختار الأستاذ المناسب ليك؟
concepts.concept: Educational explainer with real profiles: 4 things to look at (subject and level, presentation, availability, how they answer questions). Neutral, no ranking of teachers.
concepts.message: A good choice starts with the right criteria.

concepts.title: Behind the scenes of SOSProf.net
concepts.pain: Platforms feel faceless
concepts.hook: شكون اللي يخدموا ورا SOSProf.net؟
concepts.concept: Behind the scenes: the team checking new teacher profiles, answering messages, preparing content (real footage only, people who agreed).
concepts.message: A Tunisian team builds this platform for students and teachers.

concepts.title: Real words from real users
concepts.pain: Wanting proof before trying
concepts.hook: خلّيناهم يحكيو هوما...
concepts.concept: Testimonial reel, ONLY once real testimonials with written permission exist: student, parent and teacher in their own words. Until then this stays in the backlog as 'waiting for material'.
concepts.message: Users tell their own experience.

concepts.title: Studies a lot, results don't move
concepts.pain: A child who works hard without progress
concepts.hook: ولدك يقرا برشا، أما النتائج ما تتحسّنش؟
concepts.concept: Parent POV micro-story: a mother sees her son revising late every night, marks stay flat. The insight: the method, not the hours. Ends on finding a teacher who adapts to him.
concepts.message: More hours isn't always the answer; the right support is.
concepts.cta: Find the right support for your child

concepts.title: Choosing a teacher for your child
concepts.pain: Choosing by word of mouth only
concepts.hook: كيفاش تختار الأستاذ المناسب لولدك؟
concepts.concept: Expert advice (a real educator, consent): 3 questions to ask before choosing support: what's the exact difficulty, which format suits the child, how progress will be followed.
concepts.message: Ask the right questions before choosing.

concepts.title: Not every student needs the same support
concepts.pain: Copying what other families do
concepts.hook: موش كل تلميذ يستحق نفس طريقة الدعم.
concepts.concept: Problem / solution: three siblings, three profiles (needs confidence, needs method, needs exam practice). Each one gets a different kind of support.
concepts.message: Support should match the child, not the trend.
concepts.cta: Choose support that fits your child

concepts.title: Lessons that fit the child's needs
concepts.pain: Paying for sessions that don't target the real gap
concepts.hook: الحصص الخصوصية لازمها تتماشى مع احتياجات التلميذ.
concepts.concept: Educational explainer with motion graphics: identify the gap → choose the teacher → choose the rhythm. Real screens for the platform part.
concepts.message: Targeted support is better than more support.

concepts.title: School, tutoring, and still time to breathe
concepts.pain: Overloaded weeks and tired children
concepts.hook: بين القراية والحصص... وقتاش يرتاح ولدك؟
concepts.concept: Micro-story: a week planner overflowing with sessions, then rebuilt with fewer, better-placed online sessions and free time. Gentle tone, no guilt.
concepts.message: Balance helps learning too.
